g.title: MOGAD_QSP
g.text: Myelin Oligodendrocyte Glycoprotein Antibody-Associated Disease (MOGAD) — Mechanistic QSP Map
Short-lived plasmablast IgG1 source → BBB transit → complement/ADCP attack on the outer myelin lamella → demyelination with oligodendrocyte survival → relapse-driven disability
Blue = immune source · Green = target tissue · Red = effector injury · Orange = drug/intervention · Purple = biomarker · Grey = clinical endpoint · Yellow = toxicity

g.title: LEG
g.text: node carried as an explicit ODE state or key switch
Three structural commitments encoded in the map:
IgG1 source = short-lived CD20− plasmablast (IL-6-dependent niche)
Myelin is lost, the oligodendrocyte survives → high recovery ceiling, low sGFAP
Drugs act at the antibody SOURCE or the CLEARANCE/EFFECTOR node; only the latter is
